high_level_description: The image appears to be a screenshot from a news application or website. The top section of the image is labeled "WEATHER AND CLIMATE" in bold black text with a red vertical line to the left of the title. Below the title, there is a large, colorful graphic of the Earth, focusing on North America. The graphic uses a gradient of colors ranging from green (indicating cooler temperatures) to orange and red (indicating warmer temperatures), with arrows pointing upwards over the United States, suggesting rising temperatures. A large "H" is placed over the central part of the U.S.
